solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Witches and possible soldier make agreement

parts.note: a coven is a gathering of witches
a soldier is one caste of ant, so an ant is a possible soldier

explanation.surface: A band of witches and a would-be recruit strike a pact together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possible soldier' sounds like a recruit, but soldier ants are a type of ant.
explanation.definitionFit: A covenant is a formal binding pact, a solemn kind of agreement.

clue.text: Porter prepared an account

indicators.note: letters that are prepared have been worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A hotel porter has written up a statement of events.
explanation.definitionFit: A report is a spoken or written account of something that happened.

clue.text: Bank on the Spanish for poor verse

parts.note: Dogger Bank is a large sandbank in the North Sea, named in shipping forecasts
el is the Spanish for 'the'

explanation.surface: A financial institution relies on Spanish speakers to produce bad poetry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' is not a money institution but Dogger Bank, a North Sea sandbank familiar from the BBC shipping forecast.
explanation.definitionFit: Doggerel is crude, badly made rhyming poetry.

clue.text: Coventry, for example — it replaces its centre

definitions.text: Coventry, for example — it replaces its centre

indicators.note: the middle stretch of the place name is swapped out, leaving only its first and last letters around the new piece

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark on urban redevelopment: Coventry rebuilt its heart.
explanation.walkthrough: Keep only the outer C and Y of Coventry and put IT where its centre OVENTR was. The whole clue also defines: Coventry is famous for rebuilding its bombed centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Coventry is an English city in the Midlands, so it is an example of a large town.

clue.text: Apparently good to get over painful condition: have a binge

indicators.note: in a down entry, one piece getting over another sits above it, so it comes first

parts.note: pi is slang for pious or sanctimonious: outwardly virtuous
gout is a painful inflammation of the joints

explanation.surface: A seemingly virtuous person overcomes gout and celebrates with a feast.
explanation.walkthrough: Gout was traditionally blamed on overindulgence, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To pig out is an informal idiom for eating greedily, going on an eating binge.

clue.text: Big pothole in chic avenue

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of letters of the two words that follow

explanation.surface: A huge hole in the road in a smart street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pothole' suggests a road hazard, but in caving it is a deep vertical hole in limestone.
explanation.definitionFit: Potholing is exploring underground caverns; a big pothole is an underground chamber.

clue.text: Essential part of company: engineers

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army's engineering corps

explanation.surface: The engineers are the heart of the firm.
explanation.walkthrough: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps.
explanation.definitionFit: The core of something is its central, most vital section.

clue.text: Novel, not the translation

definitions.meaning: new and fresh, never done before
the source text in its first language rather than a version rendered into another

explanation.surface: A book is to be read in its first language, not a translated edition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like a noun, a book, but here it is the adjective meaning new.
explanation.definitionFit: Original means both innovative and being the first version from which copies or translations come.

clue.text: Take ages to fit in

definitions.meaning: to be at home somewhere, to be accepted in a group

explanation.surface: It can take a long time to become accepted somewhere new.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as BE LONG to get the first meaning.
explanation.definitionFit: To belong is to be a rightful member of a group, feeling at home in it.

clue.text: The old warning for farmers

parts.note: ye is an archaic spelling of 'the', as in Ye Olde Tea Shoppe
an omen is a sign warning of what is to come

explanation.surface: An ancient caution delivered to people who work the land.
explanation.definitionFit: Yeomen were historically smallholders who farmed their own land.

clue.text: Drop all the actors

definitions.meaning: let fall, shed, as a snake does its skin
the full company of performers in a play or film

explanation.surface: A director decides to sack the whole company of actors.
explanation.definitionFit: Cast means to throw off or shed, and also the complete set of performers in a production.

clue.text: Bird's colours sharp

parts.note: reds are colours, shades of red
tart means sharp in taste, sour

explanation.surface: A bird's plumage has striking, sharp colouring.
explanation.definitionFit: The redstart is a small songbird with a reddish tail.

clue.text: Mad to have gardened in a storm

indicators.note: a storm throws things about, so these letters are tossed into a new order

explanation.surface: Only a lunatic would do the gardening during a storm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a storm' rearranges the letters of GARDENED.
explanation.definitionFit: Deranged means insane, out of one's right mind.

clue.text: It may be fatal to play this when Russian

definitions.text: It may be fatal to play this when Russian

parts.words: It may be fatal to play this when Russian
parts.note: the Russian version of this casino game is played with a revolver holding one bullet

explanation.surface: A warning about a deadly game associated with Russia.
explanation.walkthrough: The casino wheel game becomes lethal in its Russian form, spinning a revolver's cylinder and firing at one's own head.
explanation.definitionFit: The cryptic description points to the gambling game whose Russian variant is a deadly gamble with a pistol.

clue.text: Punctilious type left in gummed label

indicators.note: the abbreviation for left is placed inside the word for the label

parts.note: a sticker is an adhesive label

explanation.surface: A fussy person has stuck a label on the left.
explanation.definitionFit: A stickler insists on exact correctness, a punctilious person.

clue.text: Am not able to get girl into bed

indicators.note: the girl's name goes into the word for bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed, especially for a baby
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Someone confesses they cannot get a girl into bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannot is the negative of can, so it means am not able, as in 'I cannot'.

clue.text: One in a suit in the Athenaeum, say

definitions.meaning: a card of the black suit with trefoil symbols in a pack of cards
the Athenaeum is a famous gentlemen's members' society in Pall Mall, London

explanation.surface: A man in a suit at a grand London gentlemen's establishment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One in a suit' suggests a man in formal clothes, but it is a playing card in one of the four suits.
explanation.definitionFit: Clubs is one of the four card suits, and a club is also a private members' society like the Athenaeum.

clue.text: Embrace easy task, accepting pounds

indicators.note: the word for an easy task takes in the abbreviation, holding it inside

parts.note: a cinch is something very easy to do
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Taking a simple job because it pays money.
explanation.definitionFit: A clinch is a tight hug, as between boxers or lovers.

clue.text: Offering beautiful views, since moving clutter at the front

indicators.note: letters that are moving shift about into a fresh order
only the leading letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A home has lovely views now the clutter at the front has been moved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' rearranges SINCE to give SCENI; then add the C from 'clutter at the front'.
explanation.definitionFit: Scenic describes a place with attractive landscape to look at.

clue.text: Seafood, and a sort of apple

definitions.meaning: a shellfish with pincers eaten as food

explanation.surface: A menu offers fish and a type of apple.
explanation.definitionFit: The crustacean is eaten as seafood, and crab is short for the crab apple.

clue.text: Raise male bird

definitions.meaning: lift or tilt up, as with an ear or a gun's hammer
the male of the domestic fowl or other birds

explanation.surface: Instructions to rear a rooster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raise' suggests rearing a bird, but it means to tilt up, as one does an ear or eyebrow.
explanation.definitionFit: To cock is to raise or tilt something upward, and a cock is a male bird.

clue.text: Sounds unwanted?

parts.note: the question invites a word for sounds that nobody wished to hear, a din or racket

explanation.surface: A brief question about whether some sounds are unwelcome.
explanation.walkthrough: Noise is often defined as unwanted sound, as engineers and environmental health officers use it.
explanation.definitionFit: Unpleasant or disturbing sounds are commonly classed as racket or din.

clue.text: It is painful in unfurnished carriage

indicators.note: the exclamation of pain goes inside the word for unfurnished

parts.note: a bare room has no furniture
ouch is what one says when something hurts

explanation.surface: A complaint about the discomfort of riding in a carriage with no upholstery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It is painful' is the exclamation OUCH, not a description.
explanation.definitionFit: A barouche is a four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with a folding hood.

clue.text: Musical animals? Yes and no

definitions.meaning: a stage show with songs, here Andrew Lloyd Webber's long-running one
household pets of the feline kind

explanation.surface: Are there animals that make music? Sort of.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yes and no' says the actors in that show play felines but are really people.
explanation.definitionFit: Cats is the Lloyd Webber stage show, and cats are feline animals.
